title: Sundown coverage bite-list - Jun 2029
body:
Purpose: Quick ad-hoc tally to map last-minute coverage gaps for 'sundown' reduced-support window across regions. This is a lightweight tracker — lean rows, owners, and immediate mitigations. Use during on-call handoff and launch prep.

Context: We expect reduced infra staff on 2029-06-22 (holiday overlap). Product rollouts in EU and APAC next week. Need minimal owners for: fallback routes, model variant throttles, dedicated pool thresholds.

Columns: ITEM | OWNER | REGION | PRIORITY | DEPENDENCY | STATUS | MITIGATION | ETA

Rows:
1) fallback-route-check | Arjun Patel | global | P0 | routing-config (PR#3124) | open | prewarm spare route + label; dial to 20% | 2029-06-20 EOD
2) embed-queue-shed | Lena Morales | us-west | P1 | autoscaler policy | investigating | set soft-limit 75k qps, notify SEs | 2029-06-20 14:00
3) dedicated-pool-fallback | Samir Rao | eu-central | P0 | reserved-capacity config | planned | enable warm fallback pool (short TTL) | 2029-06-21 03:00 UTC
4) metric-alert-tune | Maya Chen | global | P2 | grafana alerts | done (partial) | tune thresholds for token-cost spikes | 2029-06-20
5) customer-notify-list | Priya Nair | apac | P3 | comms template | draft | send advisory if degraded | 2029-06-21 08:00 JST

Quick notes / heuristics:
- P0 = immediate single-owner action to prevent customer impact
- P1 = actionable w/ 1-2 engineers, low infra churn
- For fallback routes, prefer model variant downgraded by quantization profile (see INF-4721)

Open questions:
- Do we ship temporary rate limits for free-tier customers? (ops + legal) -> @Lena to loop in Legal via linked ticket
- Is dedicated-pool warm capacity billable for Night Window? Finance to signoff. (linked PR for quota change: GH#3124)

Immediate next steps:
- Arjun: confirm prewarm script runs in eu-central by 2029-06-20 18:00
- Lena: post note in #oncall-change and attach final thresholds
- Samir: run failover drill in staging and paste logs into this doc

Scratch calculations (rough):
- Estimated warm fallback capacity needed: 3x baseline p50 requests per minute -> ~18k rpm
- Cost delta (warm pool) ~ +$1.2k/day if left on continuous; target 12h window to limit spend

References:
- INF-4721 (routing fallback design)
- GH PR: runtime#3124 (route prewarm automation)
- Slack: #oncall (thread 1687000000.000100)

Notes to self: Keep this file minimal. After sundown window closes, convert to log + postmortem if any P0 triggered.
